events.title: May the Compute Be With You: Separating Hype from Reality in Orbital Data Centers
events.description: GMF Technology virtual event on whether orbital data centers can meet surging AI and digital-infrastructure demand, separating hype from reality.
events.why: AI compute infrastructure meets space policy; easy to join online.

events.title: FCC December 2026 Open Commission Meeting (Satellite Market Access Reciprocity; Light-Licensing Satellite Spectrum Sharing; Local Broadcast Ownership; Robocall Blocking; Intercarrier Compensation; TRS)
events.location: Commission Meeting Room, FCC Headquarters, 45 L Street NE, Washington, DC 20554
events.description: FCC open meeting: NPRMs on satellite market-access reciprocity and a light-licensing framework for satellite spectrum sharing, plus broadcast ownership, robocall blocking, intercarrier compensation and TRS items. Open to the public; webcast.
events.why: Satellite spectrum and market-access reciprocity rules touch space and tech-competition policy; public, near Union Station.

events.title: An Evening of Discovery with SAIR
events.location: Penn Quarter, Washington, DC (address on registration)
events.host: AI Discussion Club / Foundation for Science and AI Research (SAIR)
events.description: Evening on the future of science and AI with researchers, industry and government guests; fireside chat with SAIR SVP Milo Chamberlin on the SAIR Prize and AI for scientific discovery. Approval required.
events.why: AI-for-science networking with some government guests; light on policy.
